title: Make Do not disturb times configurable with a repeating schedule
line: Do Not Disturb mode can now turn on by itself every day between two times you choose in the Notifications settings.
explanation: Do Not Disturb mode could only be enabled by hand (with fixed 'until this evening/tomorrow morning' choices) or automatically for mirrored screens, screen sharing and fullscreen apps; there was no way to have it every night. The change adds an 'Every day on a schedule' option with From/To times under 'Enable automatically' in the Notifications settings (stored in plasmanotifyrc [DoNotDisturb] OnSchedule/ScheduleStart/ScheduleEnd, default 22:00 to 07:00, off). When the start time is reached the notifications applet turns Do Not Disturb on until the end time, so it shows 'Automatically ends: tomorrow at 7:00' and can still be turned off by hand for that night.

commits.message:
notifications: allow enabling Do Not Disturb mode on a daily schedule

Do Not Disturb mode could only be turned on by hand or by a few events,
so people who silence notifications every night had to remember it each
day. A new option turns it on every day between two times of their choice.

BUG: 412471
